note: 跟着牛顿过一天 sound plan. at = [line id, 'start'|'end', offset s] or [scene, 'from'|'to', offset]: a scene's 'from' is its first frame and 'to' the next scene's first frame, read by build.py from the PICTURE's own bounds (src/videos/newton/voice.ts SEGMENT_RAW, frame / 30), so scene-anchored cues land on the cut (v2 put scenes 0.3 s early: review v2 row 4). gain in dB, ONE static gain per cue (music is never ducked: no automation, no sidechain; fades only at a cue's own start / end). loop = repeat the clip to fill [at, until]; in = seconds skipped at the clip's start; a bed entry with fade 0 is a trimmed one-shot (only its tail is cut). Clips: /home/user/newton_work/film/sound/clips (voice farm run newton-v4-sound-01). The script's sound notes: a pizzicato-and-harpsichord bed from frame 0 with a pluck on the knock; room tone changes with each place; one cello note at line 49 (F14); everything but the fire drops out after 51 (F16); the bed comes back warm with the laugh (G02) at the sack drop. Levels (v3 remix, 14 Nov, review v2 row 3, and v3b, the director's gate-4 notes; /home/user/newton_work/film/sound/REMIX_v3.md): the music cues sit 11-14 LU under the dialogue per scene (v2: 17-22) and every line stays at least 10 LU over everything under it (voice track vs the bed rebuilt with a silent voice), in the full band AND in the phone band (450 Hz-9 kHz: what a phone speaker plays; tightest F04 10.1 and G03 10.1 full band, F10 10.1 phone band). mus_night and mus_laugh carry most of their weight below 450 Hz, which a phone cannot play, so each has ONE fixed low shelf for the whole cue ("lowshelf": [Hz, dB], build.py static_eq; no automation) and a higher static gain: on a phone they now sit F 16.0 / G 13.8 LU under the voice (v3: 22.9 / 17.5); the card ding is sfx_card retuned to A5 (sfx_card_A5: python3 scripts/newton/sound/retune_clip.py <clips>/sfx_card.mp3 <clips>/sfx_card_A5.mp3 --target 880; the original rang at 725 Hz, between F5 and F#5); beds 25-30 dB under; mono mix -19.0 LUFS, true peak -1.8 dBTP (build.py --gain 6.2 --ceiling -1.8; -1.4 dBTP after mux.sh's AAC on v3b). Hits sit on the music's accents or out from under words. Her camera (Jay 14 Nov, 'recording visuals and sound effects like 秦始皇'; hud/vlog.tsx): rec_beep (the Qin film's clip, voice farm run qin-sfx-01) as she starts recording on frame 0; sfx_poweroff (python3 scripts/newton/sound/make_poweroff.py 0.80 1.07 <clips>/sfx_poweroff.mp3: the button click on the off frame, the power-down sweep 0.8 s later on segG's end black) when the camera switches off at G to - 1.4 s (= BEAT.G.cameraOff = hud/vlog.tsx OFF_AT, frame 5211). No beep at the other scene starts: every cut carries a voice line's last syllable or a scene sound ON the cut frame (B the bell, C mus_noon's first note, D the street tone and mus_lecture's first note (the big door creaks on the in-scene cut into the hall, frame 1900), E the room tone and mus_supper 0.1 s in, F the crickets, G the clock's first stroke), so the timestamp slides in silently, as in the Qin film.
